assumptions: The login popup's submit button maps to the existing locator 'login_button'
The mobile number field on the login popup maps to the existing locator 'mobile_number_input'
The OTP entry screen's primary input maps to the existing locator 'otp_input'

testcases.expected: After entering the mobile number and submitting, the OTP input screen is displayed to the user
preconditions: Browser session has no active login
steps: Verify that element mobile_number_input is displayed
Verify that element otp_input is displayed
testcases.title: Signed-out user taps Ask More Photos and reaches OTP screen after entering mobile number

prompt: Test the Ask More Photos flow on https://designtest.justdial.com/jdmart/Mumbai/Apollo-Tyre/jdm-1113060-ent-4-23785 . A signed-out user taps Ask More Photos and a login popup asks for a mobile number. Enter 9324751210 and submit; an OTP screen appears.
